audioNote.markdown:
The Emails page within the History module provides a comprehensive log of all email communications created and sent through the platform by event team members, as well as a short list of system-generated emails.

Emails are categorized into Campaigns and Sent Emails. Campaigns are a coordinated series of emails sent to a targeted group of recipients with a specific purpose. Email campaigns might be used to notify speakers of important deadlines or share acceptance updates.
